comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. Frequency is a 0 to 1 knob used as 1000 raised to that power times 20Hz, so its default of 0.5 is about 632Hz. Feedback is 0 to 0.95 and is clamped to 1 after the CV; damping is 0.25 to 1.25 and clamped there; drive is a 0 to 1 knob mapped to 0.1 to 10 by raising 100 to the power of the knob to the 0.33 and multiplying by 0.1, with a makeup gain of the drive to the power of 0.75. The nonlinearity is a hyperbolic tangent on three of the filter's four state variables.
